description: The bar chart illustrates the number of conversations across four different domains—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—categorized by whether individuals were deceived, partially deceived, or not deceived, as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Conversations," ranging from 0 to 60, while the vertical axis lists the four domains. For each domain, three colored bars represent the counts for "Yes" (deceived), "Partially" (partially deceived), and "No" (not deceived) responses. In Academic Collaboration, the "Yes" category has the highest count (approximately 36), followed by "Partially" (approximately 27), and "No" (approximately 7). In Recruitment, the "Yes" category again has the highest count (approximately 37), followed by "Partially" (approximately 24), and "No" (approximately 6). In Academic Funding, the "Yes" category dominates with a count of approximately 58, while "Partially" and "No" are much lower (approximately 5 and 4, respectively). In Journalism, the "Partially" category has the highest count (approximately 48), followed by "Yes" (approximately 15), and "No" (approximately 6). The chart shows that the "Yes" category is the most frequent in Academic Collaboration and Recruitment, while the "Partially" category is the most frequent in Journalism, and the "Yes" category is overwhelmingly dominant in Academic Funding.
